items.source: Obtain a session bound instance of SessionScoped binding the ClientSession provided by the given Supplier to each and every command issued against MongoDB.
items.translation: 获取一个与 SessionScoped 绑定的 session 实例，该实例将给定 Supplier 提供的 ClientSession 绑定到针对 MongoDB 发出的每个命令。

items.source: Obtain a session bound instance of ReactiveSessionScoped binding the ClientSession provided by the given Publisher to each and every command issued against MongoDB.
items.translation: 获取一个与给定 Publisher 提供的 ClientSession 绑定的 ReactiveSessionScoped 的绑定实例，该实例将把 ClientSession 绑定到针对 MongoDB 发出的每个命令。

items.source: Obtain a session bound instance of SessionScoped binding a new ClientSession with given sessionOptions to each and every command issued against MongoDB.
items.translation: 获取一个与SessionScoped绑定的session实例，该实例将一个新的ClientSession（带有指定的 sessionOptions）绑定到针对 MongoDB 发出的每一条命令上。

items.translation: ReactiveSessionScoped 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core 中的用途
